title: Log in
intro: Log in with Vipps, BankID or a passkey.
invited: You have been invited to VeriQall. Log in to accept the invitation.

errors.avbrutt: The login was cancelled. Try again when you're ready.
errors.utlopt: The login took too long or the session has expired. Please try again.

errors.invitasjon: The invitation is invalid, used or expired. Ask for a new invitation.
errors.deaktivert: Your user has been deactivated. Contact your manager.
errors.allerede_koblet: This login is already linked to another user.
errors.navn_ulikt: The name in BankID doesn't match the name on your user, so BankID was not linked. Ask an administrator to correct your name, and try again.
errors.ikke_satt_opp: This login method is not set up yet.
errors.feil: Something went wrong while logging in. Please try again shortly.

passkeyErrors.exists: This device already has a passkey for your account.
passkeyErrors.insecure: Passkeys don't work on this address.
passkeyErrors.failed: Something went wrong with the passkey.
